cases.why: A small model held fully in memory, as on most Macs: the engine's own speed with nothing streamed and no drafter.
A mixture-of-experts model with a DFlash drafter, held fully in memory.
The same model on a 16 GB budget, streaming experts from the SSD with its drafter loaded.
A dense model with a DFlash2 drafter held fully in memory, where it drafts fastest: the case a change of engine must not slow.
A dense model with a DFlash2 drafter at a limit just above its own weights, where the drafter and the weights compete for memory and the engine decides what streams.
A model far larger than memory with its own multi-token-prediction head, streamed throughout.
